root_cause.text: The `run_unpack()` function in fs/ntfs3/run.c reads variable-length size and offset fields from a buffer using `run_unpack_s64()` but fails to verify that the declared field sizes do not exceed the remaining buffer space, causing an out-of-bounds heap read when processing a crafted NTFS image with truncated run data.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit boundary checks (`if (run_buf + size_size > run_last) return -EINVAL;` and `if (run_buf + offset_size > run_last) return -EINVAL;`) before each `run_unpack_s64()` call, confirming that the missing checks were the root cause. The CVE description notes that the loop only checks `run_buf < run_last` but then reads `size_size` and `offset_size` bytes without verifying they fit.
